# KPI library

Starting points, not a checklist. Pick the few that match real decisions, then define each one precisely.

## KPI levels

| Level | Focus | Update frequency | Audience |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Strategic | Long-term goals | Monthly or quarterly | Leadership |
| Tactical | Department goals | Weekly or monthly | Managers |
| Operational | Day-to-day work | Daily or real time | Teams |

## By function

| Function | Common KPIs |
| --- | --- |
| Sales | Revenue, pipeline value, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, quota attainment |
| Marketing | Leads and qualified leads, cost per acquisition, customer acquisition cost, conversion rate by channel, CAC payback period |
| Product | Active users (daily, monthly), activation rate, feature adoption, retention by cohort, stickiness (daily over monthly active) |
| Customer success and support | Churn and retention, net revenue retention, satisfaction (CSAT), net promoter score, time to resolution, ticket volume |
| Finance | Gross margin, operating margin, cash flow, runway, days sales outstanding, revenue per employee |
| Subscription businesses | Monthly and annual recurring revenue, expansion, contraction, gross and net churn, LTV to CAC ratio |
| Operations | Throughput, cycle time, on-time delivery, defect or error rate, uptime and user-perceived latency |

## Definitions that often disagree

- Monthly recurring revenue: decide how annual and quarterly plans are normalized (divide by 12 or 3) and whether discounts and one-off fees count.
- Active user: which event counts, and in what window.
- Churn: customers or revenue; at the start or end of the period; whether downgrades count.
- Customer acquisition cost: which costs are included (paid media only, or salaries and tools too) and which customers are counted (all new, or marketing-sourced only).

Write the chosen definition on the dashboard card or in a linked data dictionary (see `data-dictionary`).

## Do and avoid

| Do | Avoid |
| --- | --- |
| Show comparison and target beside every number | A number with no context |
| Use status colors consistently and add a text or icon cue | Color as the only signal |
| Enable drill-down from summary to detail | Cramming every metric on one screen |
| Document how each number is calculated | Hidden methodology |
| Check the mobile or small-screen view | 3D charts and decorative gauges |
